newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends flat in dull trading.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends flat in dull trading.

text.p: The weekend closure of major international markets kept importers sidelind from the Bangladesh taka, helping the currency remain steady against the dollar in dull interbank trading on Sunday.
The taka closed flat at 43.7500/7550 per dollar.
The local currency opened at the same level and, dealers said there was little movement throughout the session.
Call money was traded at 7.75 to 8.25 percent, slightly lower than Thursday's 8.5-9.5 percent.
